fato_historico: 1898: France withdraws its troops from Fashoda (now in Sudan), ending the Fashoda Incident.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may find that letting go of past tensions brings incredible relief. Much like the wisdom of choosing peace over conflict, it is a good time to release heavy burdens you have been carrying. By clearing your own internal space, you open the door to new adventures and a heart filled with lightness and joy.
frase_do_dia: True freedom begins when we release the weight of yesterday's battles.
significado_numero: A master number representing the manifestation of your grandest dreams.
conselho: Consider choosing tranquility today; your adventurous path is clearer without unnecessary baggage.
